description: In server.rs route_method Email/changes, since_seq is parsed from sinceState via .parse().unwrap_or(0). An attacker-supplied sinceState that is not a valid decimal integer (e.g. a very large number, negative, or garbage) silently falls back to seq=0, returning the entire change log rather than returning a cannotCalculateChanges error. RFC 8620 §5.2 requires returning cannotCalculateChanges when sinceState is not recognised; returning all entries since epoch violates the contract and may leak data to a client that expected only incremental results.
title: Email/changes sinceState accepts arbitrary strings silently
